effect.name: Flovart Scene Replace
effect.targetSdk: After Effects C++ Effect SDK (version pinned at real-host gate)
effect.description: Renders one pinned local asset blended over the current frame. Milestone-1 skeleton: not compiled on this machine; see NATIVE_EFFECT.md for the External Gate checklist.

parameters.name: Asset Path
parameters.role: Pinned local media file decoded for the current frame. Written by the generation pipeline; the render path only reads it.

parameters.name: Blend
parameters.role: Mix intensity: 0 shows the original frame, 100 shows the asset.

parameters.name: Version
parameters.role: Applied asset version slot (V1, V2, ...). Full version ids arrive with the generation pipeline slice.

dataflow: load pinned file from Asset Path (the only file read in the render path)
decode the source frame matching the current integer output frame
blend asset over the input frame by Blend percent
return the composited frame; if the asset is missing, pass input through and flag a display error
nonGoals: no network access, no generation calls, no agent/browser/service dependency in the render path
no transform/mask/tracking editor — host-native controls cover those
no generic Host SDK abstraction — this file targets the AE Effect SDK directly
externalGate: compile with the real AE Effect SDK on Windows (verify SDK-VERIFY marks in FlovartEffect.cpp)
lock the asset decoder library (OpenImageIO candidate) and pixel format
apply effect, set all three parameters, save project, reopen and verify values
scrub to random frames and compare pixels against an independent reference (<=1 per channel, 8-bit SDR)
export with the machine offline; verify no generation request occurs
